traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Easily recognized mushroom due to its tall, white, shaggy cap, which turns black and begins to dissolve from the bottom up as it matures. This process of liquefying gills is known as deliquescence. It's a popular edible mushroom, best eaten when young and while the gills are still white or pink. The taste is mild and not distinctive. Note that like other members of the Coprinus genus, it should not be consumed with alcohol as it can cause adverse reactions.
